items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer discusses Eddie Heartfield extensively, but the interviewee (Cozy Cole) does not speak about any personal interaction, relationship, or specific knowledge of Eddie in the provided transcript.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. You mentioned Eddy Heartfield.
Oh God, he's great, a great musician. I remember when he was on staff at NBC, all the saxophone players wanted to study with Eddie. He's doing, he's teaching

now there at Charlie Coven's studios in New York. And he's also doing a Circus and he just got back, Ivan Rollé told me, bass player from LA, think he did a recording date under his name for the Harry Lim label.
